audit.whatIsWrong: Dredge Line was described only as having 'a long cooldown', and the terrain behaviour of the hook was never stated.
audit.why: Riot's text: colliding with an enemy pulls them and Nautilus together; colliding with terrain pulls Nautilus towards it. So a hook that hits a wall moves him, not you — that is the punish window, and the cooldown is 14/13/12/11/10s. Riptide is 7/6.5/6/5.5/5s and Leap of Faith is 120/95/70s.
audit.corrected: Stated the 14s rank-1 hook cooldown, the terrain-collision behaviour, Riptide's 7s rank-1 slow cycle, and the 120s cost of your own R.

audit.why: Dredge Line at 14s rank 1 is the single most punishable cooldown in the lane; a whiffed hook buys a full Illaoi pattern.
audit.corrected: Numbers added to spikes[0].text and wants.you[0].

audit.whatIsWrong: Nothing recorded about whether minions block Dredge Line, or whether Illaoi's spirit can be hooked.

edits.before: Once you have E Test of Spirit online you flip the lane: pull his soul while he's shoving and the vessel plus your Q Tentacle Smash slaps do enormous chunk damage. Nautilus can't outrun the tentacles because Dredge Line (Q) has a long cooldown and his shove is slow. Space so his Q is on cooldown before you commit W Harsh Lesson.
edits.after: Once you have Test of Spirit (E) online you flip the lane: pull his soul while he's shoving and the vessel plus your Q slaps chunk him. Dredge Line is 14s at rank 1; on terrain it only drags him, so make him miss, then W (Harsh Lesson) in on the whiff and let every tentacle swing before Riptide's 7s slow cycles.

edits.before: R Leap of Faith spawns a ring of tentacles and gives you tankiness; against a melee tank with no dash-away this is a clean all-in. If he lands Dredge Line to engage, R on top of him and let every tentacle slam — you win the extended trade decisively.
edits.after: Leap of Faith (R) spawns a tentacle for every champion hit and it is a 120s cooldown at rank 1 — spend it only on his commit. When he hooks in or lands Depth Charge (R), answer with yours on top of him and let every tentacle slam; the extended trade is yours.

edits.before: Land E on him while his Q Dredge Line is down
edits.after: Land E while Dredge Line is down — 14s at rank 1

notes: No fabricated ability names found in this matchup. Chart rows 0, 3 and 4 disagreed with both the packet and their own whys text; fixed as matched pairs. Did not assert minion-block on Dredge Line or spirit-targeting behaviour — neither is in Riot's text.
